title: Local Relaxation Fast Poisson Methods on Hierarchical Meshes
summary: The local relaxation algorithm is promising for fast solution of Poisson's equations, which computes the electric field distribution in a stepwise manner via local curl-free updates while strictly enforcing Gauss's law. We propose a novel hierarchical local relaxation (HLR) method for speeding up the convergence of curl-free iterations. The local algorithm reformulates the Poisson's equation into the electric-field form and sweeps each cell to minimize the associate electric energy, avoiding the solution of linear systems.
